shared_elements: figures apparently in a group or row along a rock surface
suggestion of held or carried objects
justification: Both surfaces show human figures carved in relief, apparently arranged laterally along a rock face and in profile orientation, which is about as far as the correspondence goes given A's forms are largely illegible. B unambiguously depicts a repeated procession of bearded men in identical headgear holding bowls and vessels, a specific and conventional scheme, whereas A shows only a few large, indistinct figures with no readable attributes, posture or repetition.
